verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs say its AI Assistant can search your entire email history and check your calendar, which covers the core of asking questions across inbox and calendar. Nothing documents grounded answers, such as citations or source threads, or specific 'who said what / what's outstanding' querying. Community reports also note that on the free plan, mail older than 90 days does not appear in search, which limits 'whole inbox' coverage. missing for 10: documented grounding/source citations in answers, explicit cross-inbox Q&A examples (who said what, outstanding items), independent hands-on corroboration of assistant answers, full-history coverage on all plans.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
